mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(c.id) FROM contract c JOIN sales_user su ON c.sales_user_id = su.id WHERE su.branch_id = #{branchId} AND YEAR(c.updated_at) = #{year} AND c.contract_status_code = '06' AND c.contract_result_status_code = '02'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(smt.target_contract_count), 0) FROM sales_monthly_target smt JOIN sales_user su ON smt.sales_user_id = su.id WHERE su.branch_id = #{branchId} AND smt.target_year_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(c.id) FROM contract c JOIN sales_user su ON c.sales_user_id = su.id WHERE su.branch_id = #{branchId} AND DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND c.contract_status_code = '06' AND c.contract_result_status_code = '02'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_user WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} AND status_code = '01'

SELECT su.employee_id AS employeeId, su.name AS employeeName, COUNT(c.id) AS contractCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC, su.name ASC ) AS `rank` FROM sales_user su LEFT JOIN contract c ON su.id = c.sales_user_id AND DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND c.contract_status_code = '06' AND c.contract_result_status_code = '02' WHERE su.branch_id = #{branchId} AND su.status_code = '01' GROUP BY su.id, su.employee_id, su.name ORDER BY `rank` ASC
SELECT code_name FROM common_code WHERE group_code = 'USER_RANK' AND code_value = #{rankCode}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m') AS yearMonth, COUNT(id) AS contractCount FROM contract WHERE sales_user_id = #{salesUserId} AND updated_at >= #{startDateTime} AND contract_status_code = '06' AND contract_result_status_code = '02' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m')

WITH MonthlyPerformance AS ( SELECT su.id AS user_id, COUNT(c.id) AS this_month_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC, su.name ASC ) AS `rank` FROM sales_user su LEFT JOIN contract c ON su.id = c.sales_user_id AND DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND c.contract_status_code = '06' AND c.contract_result_status_code = '02' WHERE su.branch_id = #{branchId} AND su.status_code = '01' GROUP BY su.id, su.name ) SELECT su.id AS userId, su.name AS employeeName, mp.rank AS `rank`, mp.this_month_count AS thisMonthCount, CAST(mp.this_month_count - COALESCE(smt.target_contract_count, 0) AS SIGNED) AS targetDifference, CASE WHEN dpu.pin_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isPinned FROM sales_user su JOIN MonthlyPerformance mp ON su.id = mp.user_id LEFT JOIN sales_monthly_target smt ON su.id = smt.sales_user_id AND smt.target_year_month = REPLACE(#{yearMonth}, '-', '') LEFT JOIN dashboard_pinned_user dpu ON su.id = dpu.target_sales_user_id AND dpu.manager_user_id = #{managerUserId} WHERE su.branch_id = #{branchId} AND su.status_code = '01'
AND (dpu.pin_id IS NOT NULL OR su.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY isPinned DESC, dpu.created_at ASC, thisMonthCount DESC, employeeName ASC
